subject: alt-f
title: ALT.F.------RT.DY.
description: Diagram in T(AF)M-11, on the page where Braxton argues that 'the vibrationaltory lining of creative black music is the same as the composite thrust of black culture—whether African or so-called American—yet the meta-reality and science of creative black music is separate from Africa or the world group, because of the nature of the path American black people have had to take.' (C)ALT-F (alternative functionalism) is crossed with (C)RT-DY (reality dynamics) — note the *double* (c) prefix, marking this as a crossing of two crossing-relations: the question is what 'alternative' means when both alternative-functionalism and reality-dynamics are themselves already structurally crossed. ALT-F branches to POL-ST (political state), POL-DYM (political dynamics), and PHY-U-C (physical universe context) → PRI-INFO (primary information) and PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) → AFN (affinity negation). RT-DY branches to SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics), RT-OP (reality options), and dashed-links to PER-TRS (perceived transition) — registering that perceived transition is conditional on reality dynamics, not directly produced. The argument: trans-African creativity is structurally an *alternative functionalism* whose access to reality dynamics passes through the political and physical-universe layers that constrain post-slavery black expression, with affinity negation appearing as the terminal node of the progressional-continuance chain.
